paragraphs: Info Page

We offer the following over the counter services and permits for construction, business, and special events. Over the counter plan review until 4:30 PM. General questions and assistance until 5:00 PM. Arrive in the mornings for shorter wait times. Queues may close early due to high volume.

paragraphs: Monday: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm
Tuesday-Friday: 8:00 am - 5:00 pm
The following counters have limited hours:

sections.heading: Over the Counter (OTC) without plans
paragraphs: Submit your over-the-counter no plans project in person. Remember to bring your application and completed forms with supporting documents with you. Each customer may submit a maximum of two OTC No Plans applications per review. Email DBI techq@sfgov.org if you are uncertain whether your project requires plans. See additional information on OTC projects .

sections.heading: Over the Counter (OTC) with plans
paragraphs: We offer drop-in service for Over the Counter (OTC) with plans projects.
Each customer may submit a maximum of one application per review.
See additional information on OTC projects .

sections.heading: Over the Counter (OTC) Fire-Only
paragraphs: Submit your OTC fire and life safety projects by following the above OTC with plans process.
For additional questions: (628) 652-3472
Or visit SFFD Plan Review .

sections.heading: Trade Permits (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing and Solar)
paragraphs: Apply through the PermitSF portal for:
Electrical permits without plans
Plumbing and mechanical permits without plans
Reroofing without plans
In-kind, non-structural kitchen or bath remodeling
Apply for the following Trade Permits online if you are a licensed contractor with an online DBI account :
Solar
Boiler Permit to Operate
You may also apply in person, an appointment is not required. Limit 3 applications per review.
Email DBI for additional questions at dbicustomerservice@sfgov.org visit SF DBI .

sections.heading: Technical Services Division (DBI)
paragraphs: General questions and assistance with the San Francisco Building Code.
Email for assistance at techq@sfgov.org

sections.heading: Key Programs Counter (DBI)
paragraphs: Form submittal for the following programs, please contact the programs directly if you have questions:
Accessory Dwelling Unit Program (ADU): pic@sfgov.org
Mandatory Soft Story Program: softstory@sfgov.org
Building Occupancy Resumption Program (BORP): dbicustomerservice@sfgov.org
Building Façade Inspection and Maintenance: dbi.facade@sfgov.org
Unit Legalization: unitlegalization@sfgov.org .

sections.heading: SF Public Works (BSM)
paragraphs: BSM provides the following Over the Counter (OTC) construction services in person.
Street Space permit
Sidewalk Repair permit
Inspection Right-of-Way Conformity
General BSM permitting questions
Acceptance of documents for a permit under review (Bonds, insurance, etc)
Acceptance of payments for permits via check or credit card. Cash will not be accepted.
Limit 3 applications per review
In-house and commercial permits for BSM are only accepted via the online portal /email and will not be accepted at the Permit Center.
Email Public Works for additional questions at streetspace@sfdpw.org or visit SF Public Works .

sections.heading: SF Public Works Urban Forestry (BUF)
paragraphs: BUF provides the following services and permits.
All applications for tree planting, tree removal, sidewalk landscaping, and tree protection will be accepted. Online submission is preferred .
In some cases, tree planting and landscaping can be issued OTC. Email for questions.
Payment accepted for all invoices issued by the BUF; application fees for applications that have already been submitted
General inquiries and questions
Permits not issued OTC and accepted via online/email/ by phone:
Tree Removal: Requires physical inspection and notice
Email urbanforestry@sfdpw.org or phone at 628-652-8733

sections.heading: SF Planning Consultation Services
paragraphs: SF Planning provides in-person consultation service for the following:
General Land Use and Zoning
SF Planning Code
Neighborhood plan or area plan
General questions and assistance
An appointment is not required.
Email SF Planning for additional questions at pic@sfgov.org or visit SF Planning

sections.heading: SF Department of Public Health (DPH)
paragraphs: SF DPH provides the following services at the Permit Center. An appointment is not required.
Environmental Health in-person general assistance is available during the Permit Center's hours of operation.
Applications and payments
Appointments
General questions
Email SF DPH for additional questions at EnvHealth.DPH@sfdph.org or visit SF DPH Environmental Health .

sections.heading: SF Recreation and Park Department (RPD)
paragraphs: Over the Counter Permits and Services
Services Offered: Picnic and Athletic Field Reservations, Clubhouse and Gymnasium Rental Information, Proof of Residency Verification, Payment Processing
Special Events, Film, and Weddings - by Appointment Only
To make a payment or to request an in-person appointment, please contact
Our Call Center at (415) 831-5500 (Mon thru Fri 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM)
Email: RPDReservations@sfgov.org
Contact you permit coordinator to schedule an appointment
All permits are available online at www.sfrecpark.org
For Telephone Assistance, 415-831-5500 Monday through Friday 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM, with exception of City holidays
Email: RPDReservations@sfgov.org

sections.heading: Business Permit Support Services
paragraphs: We offer support services to all businesses in San Francisco. The Permit Center and the Office of Small Business are here to support new and existing businesses in San Francisco. Our team offers high quality direct services and programs, drives practical policy solutions, and serves as a champion for San Francisco’s diverse business community.
Our staff are available to assist you in person at the Permit Center. We can also be reached by emailing us at businesspermithelp@sfgov.org

sections.heading: The Print Center
paragraphs: The Print Center provides a convenient, fast, low-cost solution for out customers' most common printing , copying , and scanning needs.
